items.sum: The holiday show is on at PPAC tonight at 7 PM.

items.h: Newport's Jessica Hagen Gallery Opens Its 21st Holiday Show
items.sum: The annual holiday exhibition opens with a reception from 5 to 7 PM on Saturday, Nov. 21, at 9A Bridge Street in Newport.

items.h: RISD Museum's Barkan Ceramics Show Runs Through March 2028
items.sum: More than 100 works from the Barkan Contemporary Ceramic Collection are on view now at the RISD Museum in Providence.

items.h: Waymo Takes the Exit: Robotaxis Pulled Off Highways in Five Metros
items.sum: After California called its driverless highway runs a public safety hazard, Waymo stopped highway rides everywhere it offered them, with no restart date.

items.h: Nicky Jam Brings Perreoland to Amica Saturday Night
items.sum: Perreoland featuring Nicky Jam plays Amica Mutual Pavilion on Nov. 28 at 8:00 PM.

items.h: Fusion Has Record Money. It Still Needs $80 Billion More.
items.sum: A new global outlook counts more fusion machines and more private cash than ever, and a long, expensive road before any of it lights your kitchen.

items.h: Cliff Booth Is Back, and He Only Plays in IMAX for Two Weeks
items.sum: David Fincher directs Brad Pitt in a Quentin Tarantino script that picks up eight years after Once Upon a Time in Hollywood, opening in IMAX Wednesday.

items.h: Gemini 4 Neon Undercuts Its Big Brother as AI Models Start Looping
items.sum: Google's new mid-tier model nearly matches its flagship for half the price, and three labs bet on a stranger way to build AI.

items.h: Christmas Concerts in Blithewold's Manor Living Room
items.sum: Four weekend afternoon concerts in December bring a mezzo-soprano and a jazz pianist to the historic Bristol estate.

items.h: Thanksgiving Weekend in Rhode Island: Buy the Cranberries Today
items.sum: Big grocery stores close Thursday by state law; then the weekend brings a lighthouse lighting on Goat Island, Warren's festival and Nicky Jam at Amica.

items.h: This Humanoid Has Floppy Arms on Purpose, and Factories Want It
items.sum: Swiss startup Embodied AI built a wheeled, tendon-driven robot that is safe to bump into and learns a job by watching a human do it.

items.h: Brad Bird's Ray Gunn Goes Noir in 70mm Before It Hits Netflix
items.sum: The Incredibles director's animated space-age detective story, with Sam Rockwell, Scarlett Johansson and Tom Waits, opens December 4.
